title: Similar - Add Linux Watchdog Syzlang Coverage
goal: Add buildable syzkaller descriptions for the Linux watchdog character device by creating `/opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_watchdog.txt` and `/opt/syzkaller/sys/linux/dev_watchdog.txt.const`, including the `/dev/watchdog#` opener, the core watchdog info struct, timeout/status ioctls, and the constants needed for `make descriptions` plus `make all TARGETOS=linux TARGETARCH=amd64` to pass.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source task’s core workflow: author a new syzlang file plus const file from scratch, then use repeated syzkaller description and full-build runs to converge on a valid result.
